Here is the full digest of confirmed in-person events on the Sunshine Coast for **11–17 May 2026**, drawn from institutional sources:

---

## 🗓️ Sunshine Coast Events — 11–17 May 2026

---

### 1. 🎭 Local Contemporary Art Prize 2026 — *Exhibition (Ongoing)*
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Date:** Through Sunday 17 May 2026 (last week!)
**Venue:** Caloundra Regional Gallery, Caloundra
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://gallery.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/exhibitions/local-contemporary-art-prize-2026/

The Local Contemporary Art Prize 2026 is a highly anticipated annual exhibition at Caloundra Regional Gallery, showcasing the breadth of contemporary arts practice from emerging, mid-career and established visual artists residing on the Sunshine Coast. Forty finalists are selected for the exhibition, and winners share $17,000 in prize money. Exhibition dates run from Friday 27 March to Sunday 17 May 2026 — this is your final week to catch it.

---

### 2. 🎨 Local Student Art Prize 2026 — *Exhibition (Ongoing)*
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Date:** Through Sunday 17 May 2026 (last week!)
**Venue:** Caloundra Regional Gallery Artroom, Caloundra
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://gallery.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/art-prizes/local-student-art-prize

The Local Student Art Prize exhibition is open in the Caloundra Regional Gallery Artroom from Friday 27 March to Sunday 17 May 2026. A companion exhibition to the main art prize, showcasing 2D works by up-and-coming student artists from the Sunshine Coast region.

---

### 3. 🎬 Silent Film Screening with Live Organ — Majestic Theatre Pomona
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Live Experience
**Date:** Saturday 16 May 2026 at 12:00 noon
**Venue:** Majestic Theatre, 3 Factory Street, Pomona (Noosa Hinterland)
**Cost:** $15 adults; free for children 13 and under
**URL:** https://themajestictheatre.com.au/eventsnew/

Every Saturday at noon, the Majestic Theatre transforms into a time capsule, screening silent films in an ambience reminiscent of early 20th-century cinema, accompanied by a live organist who breathes life into each scene. The Majestic Theatre, which was originally built as a social hall with attached shops in 1921, has been promoted as the oldest authentic silent movie theatre in the world and the longest continuously operating movie theatre in Australia. 16 May is listed as an event date on their calendar.

---

### 4. 🎭 Majestic Theatre Pomona — Additional Event (16 May)
**Category:** Concert / Music or Community / Other
**Date:** Saturday 16 May 2026
**Venue:** Majestic Theatre, Pomona
**Cost:** TBC — check website
**URL:** https://themajestictheatre.com.au/eventsnew/

The Majestic Theatre events calendar lists two separate events on May 16, 2026. This community-run, not-for-profit venue blends the charm of silent films with the vibrancy of live entertainment, offering everything from unique silent film screenings accompanied by the original 1937 Compton Organ to fun film theme nights and performances by acclaimed artists. Check the events page for the second May 16 listing details.

---

### 5. 🏛️ Lind Lane Theatre — Annual General Meeting
**Category:** Community / Other
**Date:** Tuesday 12 May 2026 at 7:30 pm
**Venue:** Lind Lane Theatre, 16 Mitchell Street, Nambour
**Cost:** Free (members)
**URL:** https://www.lindlane.com.au/whats-on

The Annual General Meeting of Nambour Lind Lane Theatre Inc is listed on 12 May, at 7:30pm. A community theatre meeting open to members and those interested in local theatre — a great entry point into this small, intimate Nambour theatre community.

---

### 6. 🎭 Melbourne Comedy Festival Roadshow — The Events Centre, Caloundra
**Category:** Concert / Music (Comedy)
**Date:** Saturday 16 May 2026 (18+)
**Venue:** The Events Centre, 20 Minchinton Street, Caloundra
**Cost:** Ticketed (prices TBC — book via website)
**URL:** https://theeventscentre.com.au/event/melbourne-comedy-festival-roadshow/

The Caloundra 2026 line-up features host Jake Howie and special guests Brett Blake, Kushi Venkatesh, Sez, and Suren Jayemanne. Join the Melbourne International Comedy Festival Roadshow as it journeys around Australia, delivering comic treats to audiences near and far, with a curated line-up of comedy legends and fresh faces from Australia and beyond. Listed as an 18+ Music event on Saturday 16 May.

---

### 7. 🎵 Sunshine Coast Symphony Orchestra — *Symphonic Horizons*
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Date:** Sunday 17 May 2026 (matinee — join waitlist)
**Venue:** The Events Centre, Caloundra
**Cost:** Ticketed (check website — waitlist only)
**URL:** https://theeventscentre.com.au/event/symphonic-horizons-scso/

Join SCSO for a musical journey around the world in 80 minutes. The fabulous Huw Jones conducts music that captures the essence of place — real and imagined. Close your eyes and be tossed on the wild seas with Brahms' Hebrides Overture, or imagine the brave Kalendar Prince from Rimsky-Korsakoff's Sheherazade. Thrill to Copeland's Hoedown, and Strauss' opening to "Thus Spoke Zarathustra" — and the highlight is the premiere of Clifford Bradley's "Sunshine Coast Symphony", featuring musical portraits of iconic local landscapes. Listed as an all-ages matinee event on Sunday 17 May, currently join-waitlist status.

---

### 8. 📚 Sunshine Coast Libraries — *"Turn Kitchen Scraps into Garden Gold"* (Making Mulch & Compost)
**Category:** Workshop / Class
**Dates:** Multiple sessions, 5 May–19 May (sessions fall within this week)
**Venue:** Various Sunshine Coast Library branches
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://library.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/whats-on/at-the-library

The Sunshine Coast Libraries are running "Turn kitchen scraps into garden gold" — a mulch and compost workshop — across 7 sessions from 5 May to 19 May, with sessions falling within this week. A hands-on, free community workshop at local library branches.

---

### 9. 📚 Sunshine Coast Libraries — *"Turn a Tote into Wearable Art"* (Fabric Painting)
**Category:** Workshop / Class
**Dates:** Multiple sessions, 1 May–14 May (final sessions this week)
**Venue:** Various Sunshine Coast Library branches
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://library.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/whats-on/at-the-library

The library is running "Turn a tote into wearable art" — a fabric painting workshop — across 7 sessions from 1 May to 14 May, with final sessions falling at the start of this week (up to 14 May). Check individual library branches for availability.

---

### 10. 📚 Sunshine Coast Libraries — *"Dive into the History of Local Fishing Spots"* (Going Coastal)
**Category:** Public Lecture / Community
**Dates:** Multiple sessions, 15 May–22 May (sessions start this week)
**Venue:** Various Sunshine Coast Library branches
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://library.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/whats-on/at-the-library

The library is running "Dive into the history of local fishing spots" — a Going Coastal program — across 4 sessions from 15 May to 22 May. An intellectually engaging local history program starting this week — perfect for the curious and place-connected.

---

### 11. 📚 Sunshine Coast Libraries — *"Glimpse" Exhibition by Cécile Bell* (Ongoing)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Dates:** Through 16 May 2026 (final days this week)
**Venue:** Maroochydore Library
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://library.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/whats-on/at-the-library

The exhibition "Glimpse" by Cécile Bell runs at Maroochydore from 16 March to 16 May — this week is your very last chance to see it. Free to view during library opening hours.

---

### 12. 🏛️ *"Intrigues"* — Bankfoot House Collection Exhibition (Ongoing)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Community
**Dates:** Ongoing through Sunshine Coast Council heritage sites
**Venue:** Sunshine Coast (check events.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au for location)
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://events.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/events/arts-culture

Step inside Intrigues, a captivating new exhibition that showcases objects from the remarkable Bankfoot House Collection, one of the Sunshine Coast's most significant and best-preserved historic collections. Free. No bookings required. A great opportunity for those interested in local history, heritage, and material culture.

---

### 13. 🌿 *"Calling All Little Scientists"* — Butterfly Garden Insect Survey
**Category:** Workshop / Class (Community)
**Dates:** Ongoing — check for this week's sessions
**Venue:** Butterfly Garden, Sunshine Coast (check sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/events)
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://events.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/events/arts-culture

Calling all little scientists! Come and have some hands-on fun in the new Butterfly Garden, learning how scientists study insects in the natural world. Working in teams, participants will set up a simple survey line through the area and observe and make notes. A hands-on science and nature event well-suited to curious minds of all ages.

---

### 14. 🎬 *Ocean Film Festival Tour 2026* — The J Noosa (13 May)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Live Experience
**Date:** Wednesday 13 May 2026
**Venue:** The J, Noosa Junction, Noosa Heads
**Cost:** Ticketed (check website)
**URL:** https://www.thej.com.au/ocean-film-festival-2026/

The Ocean Film Festival Tour 2026 is listed at The J with a screening on Wednesday 13 May. The Ocean Film Festival Tour is a beloved annual touring film event bringing together the best in ocean adventure, surfing, conservation, and natural wonder — ideal for outdoor, adventure, and ocean lovers.

---

### 15. 🎬 *Ocean Film Festival Tour 2026* — The J Noosa (14 May)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition / Live Experience
**Date:** Thursday 14 May 2026
**Venue:** The J, Noosa Junction, Noosa Heads
**Cost:** Ticketed (check website)
**URL:** https://www.thej.com.au/ocean-film-festival-2026/

A second screening of the Ocean Film Festival Tour 2026 is listed at The J on Thursday 14 May. Book early — these screenings consistently attract ocean lovers, adventure community members, and a warm social crowd.

---

### 16. 🏛️ *"Historians Tell All"* — Hidden History of the Sunshine Coast
**Category:** Public Lecture
**Dates:** Check sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/events for this week's date
**Venue:** Sunshine Coast (check council events page)
**Cost:** Likely free or low-cost
**URL:** https://events.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/events/arts-culture

Two experts tasked with unearthing missing chapters in Sunshine Coast history are ready to present — "Historians tell all — uncover the region's hidden history." This is the type of intimate, intellectually stimulating community talk that draws curious, place-connected locals. Confirm dates and location via the events page.
